scope: The assigned reviewer also edited implementation in fa346b73. This report is retained as author source analysis; its quality verdict is not independent verification. Root routed final source to a fresh Sol peer.

acceptance.reason: Run 005 reached settled Mine inventory and failed at shared_tab_click before Shared inventory was observed. Its receipt does not record whether the generic click failed from candidate count, hit testing, movement, or another condition. The current source repair has not been exercised in an owned-profile rerun.
acceptance.required_evidence: A root-guarded rerun must show the trusted click completes and the linked Vault panel's active scope becomes Shared before recording masked Shared inventory. Until then Shared access, candidate counts, and member authentication remain unverified.

findings: The click kind requires the literal Shared label, exactly one active top-level Vault role=tab trigger, a nonempty aria-controls target, and that target to be an active role=tabpanel. It then finds Shared (count) role=tab candidates only inside that linked panel; the generic click path independently requires exactly one visible candidate.

The selector retains scroll preparation, nested overflow clipping, elementFromPoint hit testing, animation and stable-point checks, disabled-target rejection, and trusted CDP mousePressed/mouseReleased. It does not call DOM click() or select a Vault item.

The caller invokes the scoped kind and then waits for the linked panel to report an active Shared (count) scope with inventory and refresh spinners clear. It does not treat click dispatch alone as acceptance.

The probe reads masked title matches in the page realm and returns only counts and fixed state booleans; it does not return Vault titles, field names, values, URLs, notes, or credentials. The run 005 receipt reports Mine candidate count zero and has no Shared inventory.
limits: The 005 failure is stage evidence only; its exact click failure mechanism is unknown, so this review makes no generic-click root-cause claim.
No browser rerun or acceptance result is claimed. The existing untracked SEO artifacts in the shared checkout were left untouched.
